sources.fullCitation: Channel Incident: the production of a Ministry of Information film, UK, September 1940. Anthony Asquith directs Peggy Ashcroft and Gordon Harker in a film about the evacuation of Dunkirk, made by Denham and Pinewood Studios for the Ministry of Information. Photograph D 1076A, Ministry of Information Second World War Official Collection, Imperial War Museums. Crown copyright, expired: the photograph was taken before 1 June 1957. Accessed 1 August 2026.

media.title: Anthony Asquith directing Channel Incident, September 1940
media.altText: Anthony Asquith directing actors aboard a motor yacht on a film set, September 1940.
media.publicCaption: Anthony Asquith directing Peggy Ashcroft and Gordon Harker in Channel Incident, a Ministry of Information film about the evacuation of Dunkirk, September 1940. Asquith directed Moscow Nights (1935), for which Kaper wrote the music.
media.publicCreditLine: Ministry of Information Photo Division photographer; Imperial War Museums, D 1076A.
media.rightsNote: Crown copyright, expired: the photograph was taken before 1 June 1957, and HMSO has stated that the expiry of Crown copyright applies worldwide. Catalogued by the Imperial War Museums as created for the Ministry of Information, dissolved in 1946.
